items.title: 4.2.1 Stack: Best for LIFO Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a stack (PDF 117).

blocks.text: Stack tab istemal karein jab data aane ki ulti tarteeb mein process karna ho, Last-In, First-Out, maslan jab wapas jana ho, jaise web pages mein peeche jana, ya expressions nikalna. Istemal: infix, postfix aur prefix expressions badalna aur nikalna; mazes hal karne aur DFS jaisi backtracking; aur text editors mein undo.

blocks.prompt: Browser ka Back button stack ke liye kyun munasib hai?
blocks.explanation: Sab se taaza dekha page pehle wapas aata hai: last in, first out.

items: Stack: ulti tarteeb (LIFO) ka kaam: expressions, backtracking, undo.
